title: EffectHUD
description: A simple Fabric mod that displays active potion effects on the HUD.
body:
EffectHUD — Simple Potion Status Display
EffectHUD is a lightweight, client-side mod for Fabric 1.21.4 designed to give you better visibility of your active potion effects. No more opening your inventory to check how much time is left on your Strength or Speed!

✨ Key Features
Persistent Display: Shows all active effects (buffs and debuffs) directly on your HUD.

Timer Countdown: Clearly displays the remaining duration for each effect.

Visual Icons: High-quality icons for quick recognition during intense gameplay or PvP.

Fabric Optimized: Minimal impact on performance and FPS.

Clean UI: Simple and non-intrusive design that fits perfectly with the vanilla Minecraft look.

🚀 How to Use
Install Fabric Loader for Minecraft 1.21.4.

Place the effecthud-1.0.0.jar into your .minecraft/mods folder.

Launch the game, and the HUD will automatically appear whenever you have an active effect.

🛠 Technical Details
Mod Loader: Fabric

Minecraft Version: 1.21.4

Side: Client-side only (works on any server!)
